summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback transactions under its previously announced share repurchase program. During July 23-29, 2026, the bank repurchased 10 million shares at weighted average prices of €11.75-12.32 per share across XMAD and CEUX venues, with cash spent totaling €4.174 billion, about 83% of the program's maximum investment. The buyback represents approximately 17.6% of shares outstanding as of 2021. This is a routine periodic disclosure under EU market abuse regulations, not a new event. Watch for program completion and potential share cancellation or capital reduction announcements.
